heading: Issuance of regulations; maintenance of rec­ords
lead: The Secretary is authorized to issue such regulations and to require the maintenance of such records as he deems necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 11 of Pub. L. 96–468 was classified to section 3810 of this title prior to repeal by Pub. L. 104–127.
